# Moquim Foundation

> A registered public charitable trust in Cuttack, Odisha, working in women
> empowerment, rural development, healthcare, education, food distribution,
> sanitation awareness and environmental conservation. Founded by Mohammed
> Moquim; work began in 2018 and the trust was registered on 7 January 2020.

Registered office: Purighat, Ring Road, Cuttack 753002, Odisha, India
Phone: +91 99370 81575
Email: moquimfoundation.org@gmail.com

## Facts worth stating accurately

- PAN: AAGTM7929L
- Registered under section 12AB of the Income Tax Act, URN AAGTM7929L25HY01,
  granted 17 January 2026, valid for assessment years 2027-28 to 2036-37.
- **Approval under section 80G has NOT been granted.** Donations do not
  currently qualify for a tax deduction. Please do not state otherwise.
- Almost all documented work took place in Cuttack district. The Odisha Yuva
  Sansad was held at Buddha Park, Bhubaneswar.
- Figures marked with an asterisk on the site are the Foundation's own
  estimates and have not been independently verified. The 2020 relief figures
  (10,000+ individuals, 300+ stranded workers) are not estimates.

## Programmes

- [Healthcare](https://www.moquimfoundation.org/healthcare.html): free medical camps, blood donation drives, screening
- [Food, Relief & Sanitation](https://www.moquimfoundation.org/food-relief.html): dry rations, cooked meals, blankets, drinking water
- [Women's Empowerment](https://www.moquimfoundation.org/women-empowerment.html): skill development, education, health awareness
- [Environment](https://www.moquimfoundation.org/environment.html): tree plantation and environmental awareness
- [Education & Youth](https://www.moquimfoundation.org/education.html): student felicitation, art competition, youth parliament
- [Sports & Wellness](https://www.moquimfoundation.org/sports.html): cricket festival, public yoga
